details: The purpose of the project is the delivery of finance and risk regulatory reports, transaction reports to the local country specific regulators in Asia Pacific region. It also includes risk engine calculations for reporting related to Counterparty Credit risk, Market risk, Liquidity risk, Basel III implementation, IFRS 9 implementation, and exposure to methodologies like VaR, Expected shortfall, PE, EEPE, CVA, etc.
projects.raw_text:
Project Summary: Local Regulatory Reporting (Asia Pacific & UK)
The purpose of the project is the delivery of finance and risk regulatory reports, transaction reports to the local country specific regulators in Asia Pacific region. It also includes risk engine calculations for reporting related to Counterparty Credit risk, Market risk, Liquidity risk, Basel III implementation, IFRS 9 implementation, and exposure to methodologies like VaR, Expected shortfall, PE, EEPE, CVA, etc.

entry.text: Project Summary: Local Regulatory Reporting (Asia Pacific & UK)
